title: Products — Frivold Digital
lede: Your networks, your cloud and your access system each send risk signals to SpaceRisk — where they meet in one bowtie your whole organisation can act on.
aria: Many Worlds Historian, Many Worlds Cloud and Many Worlds Identity send risk signals into SpaceRisk
products_h2: Four products, one picture of risk.
p_spacerisk: Enterprise risk management built on ISO 31000. Risks roll up from teams and systems into one bowtie — threats, barriers and consequences — so leadership sees what matters.
p_historian: Insights from deep analysis of your OT and IT networks. Passive monitoring that reports what it finds as risk signals to SpaceRisk.
p_cloud: Insights from deep analysis of your cloud infrastructure, reported as risk signals to SpaceRisk.
p_identity: Insights from deep analysis of your access system — who joins, moves and leaves — reported as risk signals to SpaceRisk.
